cases.name: Ashley Leann Nance-Karl
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Ashley lived a life filled with love, laughter, strength, and a spirit that was impossible to forget.

Her family described Ashley as “the loud light in every room.” She had a voice that was always heard, a laugh that could fill any space, and a personality that made her impossible to miss. She did not just light up a room—she brought it to life. Her lightning bolt tattoo was a fitting reflection of who she was: bold, vibrant, and unforgettable. Ashley had a way of making people feel welcome, and she was a friend to everyone. Whether through her laughter, her kindness, or simply her presence, she made an impression that will never fade.

A 2006 graduate of Temple High School, Ashley carried her strong work ethic and caring heart into everything she did. She most recently worked in the cafeteria at Troy Elementary School, where she enjoyed being around children and serving her school community. Her love for children extended far beyond her work, reflecting the warmth and compassion that came so naturally to her.

Above all else, Ashley’s greatest pride and joy were her four children. They were the center of her world and the greatest loves of her life. She poured her heart into being their mother, loving them fiercely and unconditionally. The love she gave them will remain a part of who they are, carried in their hearts through every chapter of their lives.

Ashley also shared a deep love for her family and treasured the relationships that shaped her life."
